aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_create
aliasModeTools.description: Create a persistent Vela Browser profile, or an explicit temporary profile. Without engine, Windows creates a Vela Chromium profile, and macOS and Linux create a Vela Firefox profile.

chromiumRuntime.description: Chromium profiles only. aliasmode (Vela Chromium 155) is the default where this computer can run it. CloakBrowser profiles on one computer can be linked to each other.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_profile_delete
aliasModeTools.description: Delete a closed Vela Browser profile.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_open
aliasModeTools.description: Open a Vela Browser browser and select it for Playwright actions.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_select
aliasModeTools.description: Select an open Vela Browser browser for subsequent Playwright actions.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_status
aliasModeTools.description: Get the selected browser state, or the state of one profile.

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_browser_close
aliasModeTools.description: Safely capture and close one Vela Browser browser.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_close
aliasModeTools.description: Safely capture and close the selected Vela Browser browser.

annotations.title: Close the selected Vela Browser browser

aliasModeTools.name: aliasmode_humanize
aliasModeTools.description: Turn human-like input on or off for the browsers this connection drives, or change its pace. It is on by default: clicks, hovers, drags, typing and form filling move a pointer on a curved path, land inside the element, scroll with the wheel and type key by key, each profile with its own stable habits. Call without arguments to read the current setting.

speed.description: 1 is the profile's natural pace; 2 is twice as fast.

pasteOver.description: Text longer than this many characters goes in at once, like a paste, instead of key by key. 0 always types; null restores each profile's own threshold (28 to 51 characters). The system clipboard is never used.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_summary
aliasModeTools.description: Inspect this profile's automatically recorded developer diagnostics: pages, console errors, failed requests, downloads and workers. Includes capture time and buffer eviction counts; no enable step is needed.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_pages
aliasModeTools.description: List this profile's pages, frames, dedicated workers and service workers with stable ids. Ids belong only to this browser session; use them to target developer tools.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_console
aliasModeTools.description: Read console output and uncaught exceptions across this profile's tabs, including severity, source location and exception stacks. Includes log/debug, groups, traces, assertions and errors. Captured automatically, preserved across navigation; cursor pagination never consumes messages.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

since.description: Return records updated after this cursor. Reading does not consume records.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_network
aliasModeTools.description: List HTTP requests in this profile: method, URL, resource type, status, failure, timing and redirect ids. Includes static assets by default. Use requestId with browser_devtools_request for headers and bodies; cursor pagination includes later status updates.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

since.description: Return records updated after this cursor. Reading does not consume records.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_request
aliasModeTools.description: Inspect a recorded request's complete request/response headers, POST data, response body, timing and transfer sizes without resending it or changing browser caching. Bodies are read on demand in byte chunks; nextOffset retrieves the rest. Binary chunks use base64.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_events
aliasModeTools.description: Read developer events from this profile: WebSocket sent/received frames, socket errors, page lifecycle, downloads and workers. Console output and page exceptions are also available. Frame payloads include encoding, byte counts and explicit truncation metadata.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

since.description: Return records updated after this cursor. Reading does not consume records.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_evaluate
aliasModeTools.description: Execute JavaScript in a specific page, iframe, dedicated worker or service worker of this profile, like the DevTools Console execution-context selector. expression may be a JavaScript expression or a function; argument is passed to a function. Returns the value and context ids. Existing browser identity and context are used.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_element
aliasModeTools.description: Inspect a DOM element in a page or iframe: markup, text, attributes, bounding rectangle and requested computed CSS properties, without changing the DOM.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_storage
aliasModeTools.description: Read the selected page/frame's cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB database names and Cache Storage keys. Cookies default to those that page or frame would send, like the DevTools Application panel; pass urls for other sites or allCookies for every cookie in the profile. Opens no helper pages and changes no storage, permissions or browser identity.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

urls.description: Return the cookies these URLs would send instead of the selected page's.

allCookies.description: Return every cookie in this profile, across all sites.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_storage_edit
aliasModeTools.description: Write, remove or clear cookies, localStorage or sessionStorage in the selected existing profile. Cookie writes accept Playwright cookie objects (url or domain/path, httpOnly, secure, sameSite, expires); name/domain/path filter cookie removal. Page storage writes take string-valued entries, removals take keys. JavaScript evaluation can edit IndexedDB and Cache Storage.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_fetch
aliasModeTools.description: Send or replay an HTTP request through the selected page/frame's real browser network stack, profile cookies and proxy. Supports method, headers and text/base64 POST body. Returns response headers and a byte-exact body chunk; captured network requests let you read the remainder without replaying. The browser's normal Fetch/CORS rules apply; no Node HTTP client is used.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

aliasModeTools.name: browser_devtools_protocol
aliasModeTools.description: Send a native Chrome DevTools Protocol command to a page in this existing Chromium profile and return its result. All commands supported by the engine are available, including developer changes. Firefox/WebKit use the cross-engine developer tools and JavaScript evaluation instead of CDP.

pageId.description: Stable page id from browser_devtools_pages. Required to choose a page when several are open.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.

playwrightTools.name: browser_take_screenshot
playwrightTools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

profileId.description: Optional. The open Vela Browser profile to act on; defaults to the selected one. Calls for different profiles run in parallel, each browser with its own pointer and keyboard.
